instruction: A Provençal lavender farm at sunset: long purple rows converging toward a stone farmhouse with blue shutters, an old wooden windmill, beehive boxes, round hay bales, a rusty bicycle against a fence, cypress trees, butterflies over the blooms, and a huge orange sun sinking behind the hills as the rows sway.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Lavender Farm Sunset. A Provençal lavender farm at sunset: long purple rows converging toward a stone farmhouse with blue shutters, an old wooden windmill, beehive boxes, round hay bales, a rusty bicycle against a fence, cypress trees, butterflies over the blooms, and a huge orange sun sinking behind the hills as the rows sway. Style: provence pastoral. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
